jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Launch Manager for global launch projects
jobs.description:
Supply Chain Launch Manager for global launch projects

Would you like to help orchestrate the global launch of new products, representing our supply chain throughout the entire launch projects?

Join a global group of skilled supply chain professionals and follow new products from early development all the way to market – as your input will ensure that we deliver the best products to people with intimate healthcare needs.

“WE play a key part in planning and executing successful launches – and we are a valued voice in the process, allowing us to set a clear direction,” explains Head of Supply Chain Launch, Global Supply Chain Management, Daniel Arildsen.

Join our highly experienced Launch department

Together, we are 7 colleagues, responsible for supply chain activities related to bringing new and innovative products to market within Chronic Care and Wound Care products. A good part of our time, we spend working with our factories in Hungary, Costa Rica, and soon Portugal.

“As we are each dedicated to different projects, discussing what we’ve learned with each other is very important to us. And we’ll be there to make sure you get to ease into the position,” says Daniel.

Ensure that supply chain is covered in every project

As part of the Coloplast global supply chain, you will find yourself in the middle of a web of stakeholders working towards launching new Chronic Care and Wound Care products. Here, you will be dedicated to specific projects, acting as supply chain lead or subject matter expert, representing the voice of supply chain and making sure supply chain is on track for launch.

Specifically, you will be the subject matter expert from supply chain, staying up to date on project progression. Moreover, you will plan the launch and make sure that systems, manufacturing, stock levels, etc. are ready for launch. And when you meet a bump in the road, you will figure out solutions with the project team.

From early project development until post-launch, you will:

•    Influence project decisions and direction early, to avoid supply chain risks

•    Drive the supply chain plan with manufacturing sites, balancing project deliverables and commercial considerations to launch on time

•    Produce launch scenarios in collaboration with other departments and ensure alignment with the rest of the organization

•    Coordinate activities at our production sites and flag supply chain risks

•    Make sure systems, such as planning, base data and distribution, are ready for launch

•    Follow up on delivery performance of newly launched items after launch

Your work may take you traveling roughly 2 weeks per year, primarily to our factory in Hungary. However, you will have a say on how the trips are planned, so they will fit with the rest of your life.

Supply chain knowledge and stakeholder management skills

In this role, you must be able to work cross-functionally, using your good stakeholder management skills to incorporate a wide range of input from across the business. Also, you can work with limited supervision in your projects, representing the voice of supply chain, making decisions, and setting a direction for your area.

Finally, we imagine that you:

•    Have a degree in supply chain or engineering

•    Have some experience, either within supply chain or logistics and a good conception of production processes

•    Possibly have some experience working in projects, allowing you to consider both commercial and supply chain perspectives

•    Are good at Excel and at adapting to new systems

•    Are fluent in English

Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please reach out to Head of Supply Chain Launch,

Global Supply Chain Management, Daniel Arildsen on DKDAAR@coloplast.com. We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate has been found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Data Scientist for Agentic Applications - Aarhus or Gdansk
jobs.description:
Experienced Data Scientist for Agentic Applications - Aarhus or Gdansk

Available in 2 locations

Viby J, Denmark, 8260

Gdansk, Poland, 80-244

Category: Information Technology

Permanent

Do you want to help shape the next generation of AI-powered business capabilities and are you motivated by turning business opportunities into intelligent agentic products?

“At Arla, we are scaling proven Data Science and Machine Learning capabilities into business-critical products that support commercial decisions across our markets. We are looking for someone who can combine strong quantitative modelling skills with modern software and AI engineering practices to help drive this journey.” says Andreas Therkildsen, Manager, IT Product Architect.

How you will make an impact

You will join a dedicated product team responsible for the Net Revenue Management (NRM) Commercial Intelligence Platform and its growing portfolio of pricing, promotion, forecasting, and AI-enabled capabilities. Working closely with commercial stakeholders, product owners, architects, engineers, and data specialists, you will:

• Build a deep understanding of pricing, promotions, demand drivers, and commercial decision-making within Net Revenue Management.

• Design and develop statistical, econometric, and machine learning models that generate actionable business insights.

• Apply Machine Learning models and inference techniques to evaluate commercial initiatives and identify revenue opportunities, and understand why the models perform as they do.

• Develop and operationalize forecasting, pricing, and promotional effectiveness models in production environments.

• Partner up with engineers and architects to establish scalable MLOps, model monitoring, and AI-enabled development practices.

• Help identify and mature new AI and Data Science opportunities into trusted business capabilities that create measurable value.

What will make you successful

You have hands-on experience with Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering and modern AI tooling. You enjoy solving real business challenges and working at the intersection of business, data, and technology. You understand that successful solutions require strong statistical foundations, trusted data, and robust engineering practices. The ideal candidate brings:

• Strong experience with Bayesian hierarchical models using tools such as PyMC, Stan, or NumPyro, combined with solid statistical inference and model validation practices.

• Strong econometrics and causal inference expertise, including price elasticity modelling, endogeneity challenges, and deriving reliable insights from real-world commercial data.

• Strong Python and SQL skills, combined with experience deploying and maintaining models through automated pipelines, monitoring, testing, versioning, and MLOps practices.

• Practical experience with machine learning approaches such as XGBoost, LightGBM, and forecasting techniques for demand and baseline prediction.

• Daily use of AI-enabled development tools such as Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar, with the ability to critically evaluate generated outputs.

• A product-oriented mindset and the ability to translate business opportunities into scalable analytical solutions.

It is an advantage if you also have experience with:

• Pricing, Promotions, Revenue Growth Management, Commercial Intelligence, or Net Revenue Management.

• Optimization techniques and decision modelling using tools such as OR-Tools, Pyomo, or Gurobi.

• Advanced causal inference methods such as Causal Forests, Synthetic Control, Bayesian Structural Time Series, DoubleML, or EconML.

• Time-series forecasting approaches such as state-space models or Prophet.

• Databricks, Spark, Azure, and modern cloud-based data platforms.

• Retail and consumer datasets, or an MSc/PhD within Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline.

What do we offer?

This position is based in Aarhus, Denmark or Gdańsk, Poland, with an expectation of 50% office presence. You will work alongside skilled product teams, architects, engineers and data specialists and can help shape the future of AI-powered commercial capabilities within one of Arla’s strategically important business domains. We offer a flexible hybrid working model, competitive salary and benefits, and opportunities for professional development in a rapidly evolving AI landscape.

Would you like to join us?

If you are ready to help turn AI opportunities into real business value, we would love to hear from you. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidate is found.

For more information, please contact Andreas Therkildsen, Manager, IT Product Architect, athec@arlafoods.com.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

As Sourcing Manager – Design-to-Order (DTO), you will strengthen NOVENCO’s competitive position by building supplier partnerships that support engineered solutions, modular thinking, cost optimisation and supply chain resilience.

**Your Impact

• Negotiate framework agreements, contracts and pricing structures that support volatile demand, complex components and project-specific requirements.

**What Drives Success

**What We Offer

• Close collaboration with R&D, Project, Quality, Product Development and Supply Chain stakeholders.

• Competitive salary and employee benefits in line with company policy.

• Standard auto-enrolment pension scheme and access to a healthcare scheme.

• Professional development and training through NOVENCollege, with clear progression paths.

**Context

**The role is part of Global Sourcing and reports to the Head of Global Sourcing. You will work at the intersection of customised customer solutions, DTO, R&D, Projects and Supply Chain, with supplier visits in Denmark and internationally.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your CV via our careers page. Applications are reviewed on receipt and interviews are scheduled on a rolling basis.

NOVENCO Building & Industry is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

Are you excited about building something customers love, shipping fast, together as a team?

We're reshaping how Product and Tech work at PriceShape, and you'll help build it. You'll join a small product team that owns its part of the product end to end. You'll ship to production every day, in small steps, behind feature toggles. You'll build with agents from your first week. And underneath it all is a genuinely hard problem. We collect and match pricing data from across the web, and it has to be complete, correct and fresh enough for our customers to act on it.

While agents write most of the code, we rely on senior human judgment and evaluation. If you want to be part of improving our product and our speed of learning, we'd love to hear from you.

For this role we expect you to be located in a time zone +-1h from our HQ in Aarhus, Denmark.

About the Role

You'll be a developer in one of our product teams, working in a small team with one or two other developers, a product manager, a designer and a tech lead.

Your team owns its part of the product, all the way from the customer problem to the service running in production. You'll build it, ship it and run it, together with the rest of the team. Developers here are part of finding the solution, not a step after it has been decided.

Not all of this is in place yet. Some of it you'll find working well, and some of it you'll help us build. Some people here have done a lot of this before, but we're all still learning better ways.

You can work on-site in our Aarhus HQ or remotely from the EU or the UK. English is our working language, and the team is international.

Shaping solutions with your team

• 
You'll hear customer problems first hand, often enough to make good product and technical calls without asking.

• 
You'll bring technical options, costs and what has recently become possible into the conversation early. We explore more than one solution for every problem.

• 
You'll cut the work so the riskiest assumption reaches production first. Nothing we plan should take more than a week to reach production.

Building and shipping

• 
You'll ship small changes to production continuously. We work trunk based with feature toggles, and roll changes out gradually so they can be turned off without a new deploy.

• 
You'll write the tests as part of the change. There is no test phase and no one else whose job is to find your bugs.

• 
You'll watch how each change behaves in production and improve it in the next deploy when the evidence says so.

• 
You'll change infrastructure through code, the same way you change everything else.

Building with agents

• 
Claude Code is rolled out across the engineering team, and agents are a normal part of how we build.

• 
Most of the detailed decisions in a working day are yours. You make them in a tight loop with an agent, guided by your team's documented product principles, design system and technical decisions. When something falls outside them, you pull in the right person.

• 
You'll keep the context in your repositories current, so the next developer or agent starts from how the code actually works.

• 
You're responsible for what an agent produces in the same way as for code you wrote by hand.

Running what you build

• 
Your team runs its part of the product in production, including availability, scalability, security and bugs. You'll be part of that, including when something breaks.

• 
You'll make sure problems show up in monitoring before customers notice them.

• 
You'll keep dependencies current and fix small issues as they appear, a day at a time, rather than saving them up for a big project.

Working toward outcomes

• 
Your team works toward outcomes, and you'll know which outcome your work serves and whether it moved.

• 
Work is done when the outcome moved or when we decided to stop. When we stop, we stop cleanly, with nothing half built left behind.

What We're Looking For

• 
7+ years building and running production software. You've built it, shipped it in small steps and run it, including when it broke. This matters most.

• 
Solid experience with TypeScript, Node, and cloud infrastructure.

• 
You've worked as a peer in a cross-functional team, shaping solutions with product and design.

• 
You build with agents as a normal part of your work, and you improve the context they work from.

• 
You enjoy working in English in an international team.

What You Can Expect From Us

• 
Empowered collaboration: Work as a peer in a cross-functional team, and closely with our commercial teams.

• 
Support and development: Regular coaching and feedback.

• 
Room to experiment: An environment where curiosity, testing and learning are expected.

• 
An international workplace: Colleagues from 25+ nationalities across disciplines and markets.

• 
Flexibility and balance: Flexible working hours, social activities, pension, health insurance and modern offices in Aarhus and Stockholm.

About PriceShape

PriceShape is a global leader in competitor monitoring and dynamic pricing. Our platform helps brands and online retailers track vendors' prices, stock availability, and trends while implementing tailored pricing strategies.

We’re a diverse team of 80 employees from 24 nationalities, working from a modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C. We prioritize work-life balance, trust, community and focus on personal and professional growth opportunities.

We offer flexible hours, social events, pension and health insurance, great work facilities and an in-house canteen.

How to apply

If you think the position is attractive and suitable, please send us a job application and your CV as soon as possible. We process and interview on an ongoing basis.

Stay close to the vessels while building a shore-based career. Join Vexve and take the lead on inspections, commissioning and optimization of Frese FUELSAVE® systems at shipyards and onboard vessels worldwide.

On behalf ofVexve, MARPRO Group is looking for a Project Engineer for the office in Slagelse. You will report to the Head of Project Engineering & Execution of the company.

The job

As Project Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring successful delivery, commissioning and optimization of Vexve's proven Frese FUELSAVE® solutions across the global maritime industry. You will be responsible for conducting vessel surveys, commissioning of newly installed systems, annual service visits and troubleshooting on existing installations.

The role combines hands-on technical work onboard vessels with office-based engineering support in Slagelse. You will work closely with shipowners, yards and internal stakeholders, acting as the technical expert during installations, drydock projects and service assignments. Between travelling, you will support project execution, quotation activities, technical evaluations and customer dialogue.

You will join an experienced team where your practical experience from onboard and ability to communicate with vessel crews and technical managers will be highly valued. The position includes approximately 80-90 travel days per year.

Professional qualifications

• 
Relevant technical education such as Marine Engineer, Mechanical Engineer or similar technical background

• 
Solid hands-on experience from vessel engine rooms, either at sea or from shipyard-related activities

• 
Strong understanding of marine mechanical systems and ship operations

• 
Experience with commissioning, troubleshooting and inspection activities onboard vessels

• 
Ability to identify root causes and solve technical challenges independently

• 
Comfortable working directly with shipowners, technical managers and vessel crews

• 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken

• 
Danish work permit and ability to work from the Slagelse office when not travelling

Personal characteristics

• 
Self-driven and capable of working independently

• 
Structured and detail-oriented in both reporting and execution

• 
Strong communicator with the ability to build trust with customers and crews

• 
Practical problem solver with a hands-on mindset

• 
Comfortable working in an international and multicultural environment

• 
Flexible and willing to adapt to vessel schedules and drydock timelines

• 
Curious and motivated to continuously develop technical competencies

• 
Professional and confident when representing Vexve onsite

Vexve offers

• 
A highly independent and internationally focused technical role

• 
Opportunity to work with innovative fuel-saving solutions for the global maritime industry

• 
Direct exposure to major shipowners, shipyards and drydock projects worldwide

• 
A combination of travel, onboard technical work and office-based engineering tasks

• 
A collaborative and experienced team environment with strong technical expertise

• 
Competitive salary package and employment terms

• 
Long-term career opportunities within an international marine technology company

Application

The application process is handled by MARPRO Group. If you have any questions to this position, please contact Nanna Lyck Cerelius, COO, MARPRO Group at +45 6110 7708.

If you are interested in the position, please upload a motivated application and an updated CV via the application button. You will receive a confirmation email from us. Please check your spam folder, if you have not received the confirmation within 10 minutes after applying, to ensure future communication.

Vexve offers:

Vexve A/S is a trusted provider of advanced flow control and energy-efficiency solutions for the global maritime industry. Through its proven Frese FUELSAVE® technology, Vexve helps shipowners reduce energy consumption, optimize cooling water systems, and improve vessel performance and sustainability.

The company's integrated solutions combine dynamic balancing valves, sensors, variable frequency drives, automation, and advanced control systems to deliver measurable fuel savings across a wide range of vessel types. Installed on vessels worldwide, the Frese FUELSAVE® system has become a recognized solution for improving operational efficiency and supporting decarbonization initiatives within shipping.

As part of the Marine & Offshore team in Slagelse, you will join a highly specialized environment where engineering expertise, practical vessel knowledge, and close collaboration with shipowners, shipyards, and technical managers drive successful projects around the world. Vexve offers an international and hands-on workplace where employees are empowered to take ownership, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to the future of sustainable maritime operations.

Global Wind Service is looking for an experienced Sales Manager to strengthen our Offshore Installation and Offshore Service business in Europe.

This is a key commercial role with responsibility for major opportunities across our offshore business. You will be involved throughout the commercial process, from developing opportunities and responding to complex tenders through commercial negotiations, contract award and handover.

The position offers significant customer exposure and the opportunity to play an important role in the continued development of our offshore business and commercial offering.

About Global Wind Service

Founded in Denmark in 2008, Global Wind Service (GWS) is a leading provider of wind turbine installation and maintenance services. With more than 1,800 employees worldwide, we support wind projects across Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific.

As part of the Fred. Olsen Group, we are committed to supporting the global transition to renewable energy through safe and high-quality project delivery, flexibility and strong customer partnerships.

Our business is international and fast-moving. Close cooperation between Sales and Operations is central to developing solutions that meet our customers' needs while reflecting how projects will actually be delivered.

Your Role

As Sales Manager, you will take commercial responsibility for customers and opportunities across Offshore Installation and Offshore Service.

You will work closely with Operations and other internal functions to develop competitive commercial solutions for a variety of project opportunities. A key area of focus will be the continued development of our lump-sum offering, including how operational assumptions, productivity, resources, programme and project risk are translated into a robust commercial model.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Leading complex RFQs and tenders for Offshore Installation and Offshore Service projects

• 
Developing commercial proposals, pricing and project-specific commercial models

• 
Further developing our lump-sum offering, together with the operational and commercial assumptions behind it

• 
Reviewing and challenging project scope, programme, productivity, resource requirements and key interfaces

• 
Identifying, assessing and managing commercial and contractual risks

• 
Leading commercial and contractual negotiations with customers

• 
Managing and developing relationships with key international customers

• 
Coordinating input from Sales, Operations and other relevant functions throughout the tender and contracting process

• 
Maintaining clear commercial alignment through contract award and handover to Operations

• 
Contributing to the continued development of our offshore sales and commercial approach

The position gives you a high degree of responsibility and autonomy in managing your customers and opportunities, while working closely with experienced operational and commercial colleagues.

The role reports to the Head of Offshore Sales and is preferably based from our office in Fredericia, Denmark or Duiven, the Netherlands. Approximately 30–40 travel days per year should be expected for customer meetings, negotiations and project visits.

We are looking for an experienced commercial professional who understands the wind industry and is comfortable taking responsibility for complex project opportunities and customer discussions.

Professional experience within the wind industry is essential for this position. You do not necessarily need to come from Offshore Installation or Offshore Service, but you should understand the commercial and operational environment of wind projects and be able to engage confidently with both customers and internal stakeholders.

You will bring:

• 
Solid professional experience within the wind industry

• 
A strong commercial background, including experience with RFQs, tenders and customer negotiations

• 
A good understanding of wind project execution and the commercial factors that influence a successful project

• 
The ability to understand and challenge the assumptions behind commercial proposals

• 
Strong commercial judgement and the ability to identify and manage risk

• 
Experience working with international customers and multiple stakeholders

• 
A structured and commercially focused approach with good attention to detail

• 
Strong communication, relationship-building and negotiation skills

• 
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken; additional European languages are an advantage

Experience within Offshore Installation and/or Offshore Service as well as experience on developing lump-sum offerings would be a great advantage.

What We Offer

At Global Wind Service, you will join an international organisation with a strong position in the wind industry and the opportunity to contribute directly to the continued growth of our Offshore Installation and Offshore Service business.

You will work with major international customers and complex offshore projects, with the opportunity to influence how commercial solutions are developed and how we continue to strengthen our offering as the business grows.

We offer:

• 
A high degree of commercial responsibility and autonomy

• 
Direct engagement with leading international wind industry customers

• 
The opportunity to work on major Offshore Installation and Offshore Service opportunities

• 
Close cooperation with experienced colleagues across Sales, Operations and other functions

• 
An international working environment across multiple markets

• 
Opportunities for continued professional and personal development

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Apply Now

If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you.

Please apply via the link on this page. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

For more information about the position, please contact Head of Sales – Tristan Domin +31682787414

TORM is looking for a colleague focused on results to work on reducing on-board energy consumption in close cooperation with external and internal stakeholders.

Are you ready to take on a new role impacting TORM’s efforts for reducing CO2 emissions?

Your Role

You will enjoy being part of a team that helps reduce TORM’s environmental footprint and improve/optimize the bottom-line.

The Technical Decarbonization team is responsible for measuring, analyzing and determining actual fleet performance as well as engaging in implementation of projects for fulfilling TORM’s CO2 emission reduction goals.

Apart from reducing fuel consumption, you will be supporting TORM’s Tanker and Technical Divisions by delivering value adding data analysis and decision support by utilizing available data from the fleet and the office.

We are implementing NEXUS, our in-house made common platform for sharing information.

This position will be reporting to Head of Technical Decarbonization and working from TORM’s office in Copenhagen.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Become the NEXUS Master able to follow the data from sensors to the user interface and to qualify whether the data is sufficiently accurate.

• Use your creativity to build User interface models for our NEXUS software.

• Supervise and drive the creation of Automated Guidance making sure they are meaningful and correctly identifies saving opportunities.

• Carry out pilot projects on energy efficiency technologies when new ideas must be tested.

You will also have duties on:

• Daily energy efficiency evaluation and intervening the vessels with significant excess fuel consumption.

• Do vessel visits as and when business activities permit.

• Engage with Senior officers onboard to support constant power & voyage optimization.

• Discuss specific energy efficiency topics with Vessel Managers.

• Coordinate knowledge sharing and collaboration across technical, tanker, and vessel management teams on energy efficiency topics.

Your Profile

The ideal candidate has a background as marine engineer or deck officer with sailing experience, preferably on tankers.

Equally important the person we look for is:

• Result-driven and focused on operational performance.

• Takes personal ownership, works on own initiative and follows tasks through to completion.

• Experience collaborating with vessel crews and shore-based colleagues to identify issues and implement operational improvements.

• Understanding that shipping is a 24/7/365 business and being flexible when occasional work outside normal hours is needed.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

• Fluent in English, written and spoken

• A cooperative contributor who demonstrates broad cultural awareness and understanding

• Experience from the product tanker industry is a great advantage

As the work environment is very important to us, the right candidate will be one who can contribute to the positive social atmosphere in the team.

What We Offer

A competitive salary which will reflect your experience and qualifications, and an attractive benefits package including bonus, life and health insurance.

Furthermore, we believe in freedom and flexibility under responsibility, so the office hours can be adjusted to accommodate your work life balance.

The team spirit is very important to us, and we value bonding across departments.

Furthermore, we have attractive office buildings with a great lunch scheme.

How to Apply

For further information about the position, please call Head of Technical Decarbonization, Per Moelris (+45) 2072 7270.

Please submit your application and CV via our website www.torm.com/careers/ashore as soon as possible and no later than 25. November 2026.

Applications are evaluated continuously, and interviews will take place as soon as possible.

Your application will be treated professionally, and our reply will be sent to the e-mail address from which you submitted your application.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about clinical trial supply management? Do you have experience within GMP/GDP-regulated environments and managing complex clinical trial supply chains?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Clinical Trial Supply Manager.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

As Clinical Trial Supply Manager at Ascendis Pharma, you will be responsible for managing selected areas of the Clinical Trial Supply Chain in collaboration with internal and externally stakeholders. The Clinical Trial Supply (CTS) department comprises three closely collaborating teams: CTS - Coordination, CTS-IRT and CTS - Preparation & Handling.

We are seeking a passionate Clinical Trial Supply Manager to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in managing the clinical trial supply activities across Phase 1-3 studies. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be part of a dedicated and highly experienced Clinical Trial Supply department comprising 12 colleagues. The position is based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will depend on your experience and may include:

• Coordinating internal CTS trial meetings and activities and collaborating with internal departments incl. CMC, Trial Management, QA, IT, and Regulatory Affairs

• Forecasting, planning, and facilitating the supply of IMP for clinical trial supplies, including managing IMP Packaging and Labelling activities, packaging design, label text development, and planning of packaging runs

• Managing IRT setup, incl. IRT specification, UAT preparation and execution, Go-live and close-out, as well as managing IRT system changes after Go-live

• Managing IMP distribution from CMOs to clinical sites incl. direct-to-patient (DtP) shipments and management of temperature excursions during storage at depots and clinical sites and during shipments

• Managing drug accountability activities, including returns, reconciliation and destruction

• Participating in meetings with CMOs, suppliers and vendors, trial teams and Investigator Meetings

• Maintaining documentation in the QMS and eTMF, including reviewing and preparing trial-related instructions and manuals

Qualifications and Skills:

Ideally, you hold a relevant academic degree in pharmacy or a related field and have at least 5 years of relevant experience in clinical trial supply management or a GMP/GDP-regulated environment.

Furthermore, you have:

• Proven experience in managing complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders

• A strong understanding of regulatory requirements

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office

• Fluency in written and spoken English and Danish

Key competencies:

You are a collaborative and quality-focused team player with a structured and analytical approach to your work. You are adaptable, take ownership, and have a can-do attitude. You thrive in a fast-paced, informal environment where priorities may change and close collaboration is key.

Travel: 2–10 days per year

Office: Denmark, Hellerup, Tuborg Havn

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Sara Østergaard, Director Clinical Trial Supply PM Team at sbo@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

Your mission

You’ll be the person who makes sure Klimate’s numbers are accurate, on time and a reliable source of truth. As our Finance Manager, you’ll own the books, the close and the reporting, as well as the data behind them. You’ll make sure what goes into our finance reports is correct, traceable and something leadership can rely on.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both finance and data. The foundation is finance: closing the books, reconciling balances and working with our external bookkeepers and auditors. Alongside that, you’ll use SQL, BI and automation, including AI, to validate data across systems, remove manual steps and improve how finance and operations work together. If you like figuring things out and building the solution yourself, there’s a lot of room to do that here.

Finance at Klimate is closely tied to the business. Every contract, credit delivery and supplier payment shows up in the numbers, so you’ll get a front-row view of how the company actually runs. You’ll work side by side with our CFO on strategic matters, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. You’ll have a big impact on how we scale.

About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. We value deep collaboration and working side-by-side in our central Copenhagen office, from where we support leading clients including Implement Consulting, Nykredit, Copenhagen Airport and many others.

You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

What you'll do

In your first 3–6 months: keep the numbers right and make the data trustworthy

• Learn Klimate’s commercial and accounting flows from contracts and allocation through invoicing, payments, credit delivery, revenue recognition and balance-sheet treatment.

• Own the month-end and year-end close from start to finish. You’ll work with our external bookkeeper and make sure the final numbers are right, keep payables and receivables on track, follow up on late payments, and support the annual audit.

• Be the quality gate for our external bookkeepers. Give them the right input, check their output, and make sure what reaches the CFO is correct.

• Deliver practical improvements to priority finance/data flows and reporting processes, reducing manual hand-offs and reconciliation where possible. This includes establishing a documented discrepancy-management process.

• Spot the first manual, error-prone steps in our workflows and start fixing them.

• Support with operational and ad hoc tasks that keep the business running smoothly.

From there: build what’s missing and give management the full picture

• Build the dashboards and overviews leadership uses to steer the company, from cash and margins to carbon-credit stock.

• Collaborate closely with the CFO on management reporting. Support budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning.

• Decide how new deal types, supplier agreements and carbon-credit purchases should be handled in our accounting, and make sure the treatment holds up at audit.

• Set up and continuously improve our finance processes, systems and controls. Automate wherever it makes sense, using whatever tools fit, AI included.

• Own reliable, traceable datasets and reporting that support finance and cross-functional decisions.

• Lead a prioritised roadmap for improving end-to-end data flows and related processes across finance, purchasing, allocation and stock. Collaborate with technical colleagues on integrations and data-models, including bringing AI-supported automations into our workflows.

Requirements and skills

Must-have skills and experience

• Solid accounting experience, including owning the books for a whole entity, with a strong understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow. You take pride in reconciliations that tie out, and you always trace discrepancies back to their source.

• Experience with the full finance cycle: month-end close, management reporting, annual accounts and working with auditors.

• Advanced Excel modelling skills, practical SQL experience such as writing queries and joining datasets, and a good understanding of BI tools.

• Experience with automating workflows, tasks or reporting, and using AI in practice. You’ve taken manual, complicated processes and made them faster, simpler or automatic.

• Financial analysis skills and the ability to turn data and numbers into clear, evidence-based recommendations.

• Professional English is required. Being able to read and understand Danish is preferred.

Nice-to-have

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, VAT and statutory reporting requirements.

• Experience from a smaller company, with hands-on internal finance ownership.

• Interest in climate, sustainability or carbon markets is a plus.

Who you are

• Reliable and trustworthy, with high integrity. You check your own work and make sure the underlying data and the reporting agree.

• Self-driven and you follow through. You see tasks through to completion and ask for input along the way when you need it.

• Energised by a blank page. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy building structure where there isn’t any yet.

• Curious about the business. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do, not just report them.

• A clear communicator. You work well across teams, and you’re not afraid to hold others accountable. You have the judgement to know when to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the must have criteria.

What we offer you

Beyond our mission and team culture, we aim to provide a workplace where you can grow professionally and contribute meaningfully to an industry that is rapidly evolving. We offer a competitive compensation package, opportunities to develop your skills, and an environment built on ownership, collaboration and trust.

Benefits

• Vacation: 30 days of paid holiday (5 weeks + 1 week of “feriefridage”).

• Pension & health insurance: Employer-supported pension scheme including health insurance.

• Learning & development: Annual learning budget to support your professional growth.

• Warrants: Eligibility for our warrant program depending on role and seniority.

• Flexibility: We have a weekly work from home day, and offer flexibility in working times and locations as needed.

• Central office location with lunch and great coffee: Cozy office located right next to Nørreport with a catered vegetarian lunch every day and excellent coffee provided by our clients Original Coffee and Prolog.

• Social activities: Weekly wrap up sessions every Friday and a variety of social activities, from foraging and cooking in Amager to trying our hand at pottery.

Start & logistics

We will review applications on an ongoing basis and hire when we find the right candidate.

Start date: ASAP

Location: Copenhagen

What to include in your application

• Your CV and a short cover letter (PDF) - please highlight in the Cover Letter how you are combining finance and data or automations in your work

• Please leave out photos and identifying characteristics such as age, gender, nationality, etc.

Our hiring process

• 30 min intro interview with our People & Culture Partner

• Interview and short assignment or case with CFO + a team member

The final candidate will have:

• Reference check

• Final conversation with our CEO, Mads Emil

• Offer

How to apply:

If you're interested in the role, please apply by filling in this form and selecting “Finance Manager - Data & BI”.

Equal opportunities

Klimate is committed to equal opportunities for all people and ideas.

Even if you think you don’t meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply.We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and strive to ensure an objective selection process.

Please leave out your date of birth, gender, marital status, nationality, photo, and other personal characteristics from your CV and application.

Do you enjoy turning complex business requirements into clear, practical software solutions? Join Keylane as a Business Analyst and help shape the pension processes that support people through important life events, from retirement to disability and the loss of a loved one.

Key about your team

You will join Life Events, an area of approximately 70 colleagues working at the heart of Plexus, our pension platform. We are organised into three teams that support pension processes related to retirement, death and disability, as well as premium and benefit calculations. You will be part of Life Events B, a team with 30 colleagues across Denmark, Netherlands and India. Our developers, testers and business analysts work closely together throughout the development process, from planning to delivery. Guided by client needs, we combine business knowledge and technical expertise to deliver a standardised, consistent solution across clients and countries.

Key about your role

As a Business Analyst in the Life Events department, you will work closely with our Product Owner, Development team, and and Delivery to ensure our products continue being the leading solutions. You will analyse and elaborate requirements coming in from our customers via Delivery and help evolve and design a standard solution to support customer’s needs.

You will have responsibility of tasks that include:

• Analysing business requirements for pension processes and translating them into clear development and test tasks.

• Shaping functional solutions and guiding developers throughout implementation within Life Events— Ranging from supporting brand new processes within the system, to help defining the implementation of new calculations.

• Demoing new features and enhancements to stakeholders.

• Supporting in quality assurance, through testing and bug intake.

Key About you

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with complex systems, customers and calculations, and thrives on collaborating across international teams.

Ideally, you have:

• An educational background in pension, math, IT or a related field.

• At least +5 years experience with software projects.

• Experience with or knowledge of the pension industry – this is a strong advantage.

• Experience with SQL or are comfortable working with databases and data analysis is a plus.

• Have a hands-on mindset, take ownership, and are comfortable driving tasks and issues forward.

• Strong numerical and analytical skills, as many of the tasks involve working extensively with data and calculations.

• Experience gathering and breaking down complex requirements into actionable tasks within IT projects.

• Communicate confidently in English.

Using AI

• You have used AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot or Cursor, in your work or your own projects.

What we offer

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment.

• A profit share.

• Inclusion days where you decide when to hold your public holidays.

• Five weeks of vacation and five Keylane days.

• A pension scheme where 13.25% is paid by Keylane and the individual contribution is 3%.

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively.

• The Danish office is located a 10-minute walk from Islands Brygge Metro station.

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement.

• Salary: For this role, the Monthly Base Salary ranges from 50.000-60.000 (DKK), corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

*Please submit your application, including your CV. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

*A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to Martin Bo Heiberg, manager martin.bo.heiberg@keylane.com

If you have any questions, please send an email to manager of the team, or Talent Acquisition Specialist, Lykke Kæstel Alsgren at lykke.alsgren@keylane.com.

jobs.occupation: Senior Principal Program Manager – Product Development
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US, US

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Product Development at SimCorp is building a Strategic Program Management capability from the ground up. We are a 3,000-person fintech on a mission to be the world's leading investment management platform, and Product Development, our largest organizational unit with around 1,600 people, is where the work gets done. Programs and projects of real strategic consequence are already in motion.

This role sits within the Strategy & Transformation team, working directly alongside the Senior Director of Strategy & Execution. You will help drive a portfolio of cross-functional programs and projects spanning AI strategy execution, engineering tooling, process transformation, compliance, and platform migration. The work is varied, consequential, and visible at the most senior levels.

If you are a hands-on program manager who thrives on complexity, builds structure in ambiguous environments, and gets things done across a matrixed organization by building trust and collaborating across teams, this is your role.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

• Own delivery of a defined set of cross-functional programs and projects from the Product Development portfolio, with full accountability for outcomes, milestones, risks, and stakeholder communication.

• Role model, define and drive how Strategic Program Management operates inside Product Development, with regard to standards, tools, and ways of working.

• Coach and assist colleagues leading programs and projects in PD.

• Coordinate across Product Management, Platform, and Application Engineering to resolve cross-functional dependencies and keep delivery on track and aligned to our strategic goals.

• Partner with Change & Organizational Development and the wider organization where programs require shifts in ways of working or organizational behavior.

The current portfolio of initiatives spans AI transformation, platform migration and tooling, delivery model transformation, change of ways of working, and compliance and risk governance. These are live initiatives with delivery pressure, cross-unit dependencies, and direct visibility at CPTO and senior leadership level. Initiatives vary in scale and complexity, and the mix evolves with Product Development's strategic priorities.

WHO YOU ARE

You are an experienced, hands-on and pragmatic program manager who combines structured thinking with the interpersonal confidence to drive accountability in a matrixed organization. You know that getting things done in a matrixed organization depends on understanding what other teams need, not just what you need from them. That takes investment in relationships, not just process, and you invest in both.

You are comfortable holding multiple programs or projects simultaneously, switching between strategic and operational thinking as the situation demands. You produce crisp updates and governance material, and you escalate early rather than late.

The combination of technical tooling, AI strategy, process optimization, and compliance work in this portfolio does not intimidate you. You do not need to be the subject matter expert. You need to be the person who ensures the right people are in the room and the work moves forward in a collaborative way. Ambiguity and competing demands do not unsettle you. You find the practical path and bring people with you.

WHAT WE VALUE

• 6+ years in program or project management roles, ideally with some years within a technology or product development organization.

• Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional initiatives with multiple workstreams and senior stakeholder engagement.

• Experience across both structured program management (governance, planning, risk management) and delivery-focused project execution.

• Experience building or improving program management practices, governance, and ways of working that teams and senior leaders use.

• Familiarity with engineering tooling environments and the ability to coordinate technical migrations or platform implementations without being the technical lead.

• Experience with compliance-related programs (GDPR, RoPA, ERM) is a plus.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication. You produce crisp executive material and inspire confidence in senior leadership forums.

• A direct, structured, and collaborative working style. You build alignment without softening the hard conversations.

• Degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field. Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is a plus.

BENEFITS

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually**. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Role: Service Delivery Manager

Department: Managed Services

Visa Sponsorship: You must have legal working rights in the country of your residence within the European region. Sponsorship is only available within the Netherlands.

What is your goal? As a Service Delivery Manager, you are accountable for delivering high-quality managed services to international customers. You oversee complex service environments across Dynamics 365, Azure, integrations, and data, ensuring operational stability, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement.

**Leading Microsoft Partner

**HSO belongs to the elite Microsoft Dynamics Inner Circle for 21 years, within the top 1% of all Microsoft partners worldwide. With over 2,800 professionals, and a worldwide presence, we deliver successful implementations across industries globally.

**HSO International

**At HSO International, you’ll join a diverse team of 300+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities, working on cross-border projects that make a global impact.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: https://www.hso.com/en/campaigns/life-at-hso-international/

**Responsibilities

**

• Own end-to-end service delivery across Dynamics 365 F&O, CE, Azure, integrations, and data solutions.

• Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and align services with their business objectives.

• Lead and coach the DevOps customer support team.

• Own SLAs, service performance, budgets, escalations, and continuous improvement.

• Lead Release & Change Management, including release governance, CAB processes, risk assessment and production deployments.

• Coordinate releases and resolve dependencies across functional and technical teams.

• Identify opportunities to improve and expand customer services.

• Contribute to service delivery standards and best practices within Managed Services.

**When Are We a Match?

****You Have

**

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, IT, or a related field.

• At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience within Microsoft Dynamics 365 and enterprise managed services.

• Senior-level Service Delivery Management experience in complex customer environments.

• Proven ownership of multiple services across Dynamics 365 F&O, CE, Azure, integrations, and data.

• Proven Release & Change Management experience, including release governance, CAB processes, and production deployment ownership.

• Experience managing SLAs, budgets, service quality, customer satisfaction, and escalations.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft cloud solutions and modern service management practices.

• Experience working with international customers and distributed delivery teams.

• Commercial awareness and the ability to support service growth opportunities.

• Fluency in English.

**Strong Advantages

**

• Experience transitioning projects into managed service operations.

• Experience with Dynamics 365 One Version Management.

• ITIL certification or experience working for a Microsoft Partner.

**You Are

**

• Accountable and customer-focused.

• Able to oversee complex services involving multiple technologies and stakeholders.

• Calm and decisive when managing escalations and production risks.

• A strong communicator who can translate complex topics into clear decisions and actions.

• Collaborative, proactive, quality-minded and commercially aware.

**Why should you choose HSO International?

****Development and growth

**You get a job with plenty of career opportunities with a leading provider of innovative enterprise business solutions and distinct Microsoft Global Solution Integrator, who perceives your motivations, talents and ambitions.

**Fun and success

**You work in a collaborative and professional environment where success is built on teamwork and with colleagues who are ready to help each other.

**International project exposure

**Joining our team offers an exciting opportunity to engage in international projects, providing invaluable exposure to diverse cultures, markets, and perspectives. Through your involvement in these projects, you will broaden your global network, enhance your cross-cultural communication skills, and gain firsthand experience in navigating the complexities of international collaboration.

**Freedom and responsibility

**You have the freedom and flexibility to organize your workdays, but especially to shape your own career.

**Take the next step!

**Does the combination of business processes and Microsoft technology appeal to you? Take the next step in your career path with HSO International!

We are partnering exclusively with our Private Equity client as they build out their new Commercial Finance capability to support the next phase of growth. This is highly commercial leadership role, embedded within the business and partnering directly with senior operational and commercial stakeholders - rather than sitting within a traditional reporting function, you'll operate at the heart of decision-making, helping leadership teams navigate growth, complexity and change while shaping how commercial performance is understood and managed across the organisation.

As Commercial Finance Director, you will act as the senior commercial sparring partner to your leadership team, turning financial and operational data into clear insights that drive action. You'll identify the key drivers behind performance, challenge assumptions, evaluate strategic opportunities and ensure investment, pricing and resource decisions are grounded in sound commercial thinking. Working closely with business leaders, you'll build robust business cases, highlight risks and opportunities before they emerge in reported results, and create greater accountability around performance. Success in the role will come from your ability to influence senior stakeholders, balance commercial judgement with analytical rigour, and provide the constructive challenge needed to improve outcomes.

About You

• Experience in Commercial Finance, Strategy, Consulting, Sales Operations or a similarly commercial and analytical environment ideally within the Technology/SaaS industry.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and shape business decisions.

• Strong commercial acumen with a genuine interest in understanding business performance and growth drivers.

• Comfortable moving between strategic thinking and hands-on analysis.

• Experience partnering with senior operational or commercial leaders.

• Confidence to challenge assumptions, push back where necessary and provide an independent viewpoint.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex issues clearly and concisely.

• Experience in technology, software, recurring revenue, subscription or other data-led business models would be advantageous.

• Finance or accounting qualifications are welcomed but not essential.

• A naturally curious, proactive and commercially minded approach.

• Experience operating within a Private Equity backed environment would be beneficial

This role will operate as a hybrid engagement with circa 2-3 days onsite in the Copenhagen office - representing an excellent opportunity to network and build relationships with key stakeholders with the organisation. There may be occasional travel required within Europe, but this will be limited and only to meet business needs - expect to be largely based in Copenhagen.

To hear more please apply directly.

**Role and impact

**How do you help a new catalyst product move from development towards production? In this role, you’ll work at the practical heart of scale-up: designing, building and commissioning a catalyst production pilot line, then using it to run tests, develop process knowledge and deliver new capable products to our production plants. Your work will also support production teams with troubleshooting and help plant engineering make informed equipment decisions.

**Responsibilities

**Your primary objective will be to deliver capable new catalyst products, supported by well-established and understood process windows, to the industrialization step—the next stage in our new product development stage-gate model.

You will plan and carry out work safely, optimize equipment and processes, report your findings, and document relevant best practices. You will also work with production and engineering colleagues to address equipment and process needs.

**This Will Involve

**

• Designing, building and commissioning equipment for a catalyst production pilot line.

• Performing tests at the Manufacturing Development Centre, including completing safety assessments and reporting results.

• Troubleshooting production challenges and supporting problem-solving as a subject-matter expert in relevant unit operations and equipment.

• Assisting plant engineering and EPCM with equipment selection, testing (on site or at vendors) and reviews.

**What You Will Bring

**

• Equipment and/or unit operation subject matter expert in e.g. powder handling, milling, screening, continuous furnaces etc.

• Experience in Plant process engineering and commissioning experience

• Minimum 7 -10 years of relevant experience

• Experience troubleshooting and solving problems in industrial production processes.

• A practical, hands-on approach and confidence working directly with equipment.

• The ability to write clear, scientifically sound reports in English and communicate fluently in English, both spoken and written.

• Flexibility to manage changing priorities and work to tight timelines.

• Ability to work with several tasks and projects simultaneously, being robust/resilient when faced with challenges

**It Would Also Be An Advantage To Have

**

• Experience with production process scale-up or scale-down.

• Danish, both written and spoken or with a willingness to learn the language

• Project management experience.

• Knowledge of risk assessment, data handling or statistics

• Ability to think strategically and proactively seek information with respect to what is needed for future pilot development, Project manager experience, knowledge on risk assessment.

• Knowledge on data handling and statistics an advantage

**Why join us

**You’ll have the opportunity to be a part of accelerating new catalyst products to the market by building and operating a pilot facility, take part in practical testing, optimizing, and solve real equipment and production challenges. The role brings together design, hands-on problem-solving and technical reporting, with work that supports scale-up and manufacturing development.

**Your new Team

**You’ll join R&D’s Scale-up and Manufacturing Development team. You’ll work with colleagues involved in developing and industrializing new catalyst products, pilot testing, production troubleshooting and plant engineering support. The team’s work connects equipment and process development with the needs of industrial production.

**How You Can Apply

**If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.

**Application deadline: 23-11-2026.

**If you have questions regarding the role, feel free to reach out to Ninna Halberg Jokil, Director- Scale up and Manufacturing development, on NIH@topsoe.com.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.

To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.

**About Us

**Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.

We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.

We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

At Topsoe we strive towards having a safe work environment. We are aware of the risks in our work and continuously optimize our safety procedures.

Activation at Sunrise TcTa is where business and brand strategy connect with content, creativity, media and tech. The team focuses on effectiveness — achieved through proven frameworks that align strategy and activation, driving measurable results for both Danish and international brands, mostly within the B2B sector.

We believe tactics without strategic understanding never lead to real impact… and the other way around.

Right now, we’re reshaping our setup to bring content, creative and media even closer to business and brand strategy.

About the position

We’re looking for a Paid Social Strategist to help set the direction for our paid media discipline within Activation together with the team and the management group.

You’ll bridge performance and media with strategy and creativity, ensuring that every campaign and initiatives delivers on marketing and sales KPIs as well as strategic objectives across brand, marketing and comms.

The role combines hands-on paid media management with strategic consultancy on LinkedIn and Meta.

It’s a plus if you also have experience with HubSpot and enjoy collaborating closely with our Content, Tech and Brand Strategy specialists.

Your tasks will include

• Plan, manage and optimise paid campaigns — primarily on LinkedIn and Meta.

• Translate business and brand strategies into actionable paid media plans that drive measurable results.

• Collaborate with Content, Tech and Brand Strategy specialists to ensure integrated execution.

• Advise clients on how paid, content and tech can strengthen marketing and sales effectiveness.

• Contribute to developing our paid frameworks and thought leadership within B2B activation.

• Work closely with the team on performance reporting and the use of HubSpot to connect paid activity to pipeline and revenue.

Your profile

• 3–5 years of experience in paid media strategy and execution, preferably within B2B marketing.

• Proven experience managing LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Meta Business Suite.

• A strategic mindset with strong analytical and creative understanding.

• Confidence in client dialogue — able to advise senior stakeholders.

• Interest in cross-disciplinary collaboration and working closely with other specialists.

• Experience with HubSpot is a plus.

About Sunrise TcTa

Sunrise TcTa isn’t a large conglomerate agency with standardised processes. We’re a privately-owned boutique agency based in Copenhagen. Independent and built to develop tailor-made strategic and creative solutions across industries, mostly B2B and often with an international footprint.

We’re a team of 30+ advisors, including brand and content strategists, creatives, designers, project managers and anthropologists.

Transitions are never easy.

But they’re often necessary.

Join us in working with the commercial ones.

Sunrise TcTa – Brand, Marketing & Commercial Strategy.

How to apply

If Sunrise sounds like the place for you, send your application and CV no later than 30 November 2026.

Please submit your application using the form below.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to reach out to Jonathan Riis Gilmartin, Partner, Activation at jrg@sunrise.dk or by phone at +45 51 93 21 32.

**Our Purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**As our Lead Engineer- Data, you will set the architectural direction of the data platform that enables both the decisions we make internally and the data-driven features our customers rely on. Working with the Data, ML, Platform, and Product Engineering teams, you will keep ingestion, modelling, and orchestration dependable, and define the modelling, testing, and documentation standards the data function depends on. You will innovate on how people work with data, building the agentic tooling and semantic modelling that let teams across Planday work from trusted data with confidence.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Set the architectural direction of our data platform so it serves analytics, product engineering, and AI/ML from one coherent design, collaborating with Platform and ML engineering on shared infrastructure.

• Design the dbt models, semantic layer, and quality standards the data function depends on, with the validation and lineage to make them trustworthy downstream.

• Own orchestration and observability in Dagster, and onboarding new sources in a way that scales.

• Innovate on self-serve and AI-enabled analytics, from semantic models and agentic workflows to our BI layer.

• Build the historical and low-latency foundations that make predictive and real-time use cases possible.

• Introduce better modelling standards, tooling, and development environments.

• Keep the platform reliable, performant, cost-effective, and compliant.

**Success looks like

**

• Architecture that holds up as we scale and as new use cases emerge, and that other engineers follow as a pattern.

• Analysts ship faster and more efficiently because your tooling & standards remove friction.

• A drop in repeat requests to the data team, as stakeholders answer their own questions through agentic workflows.

• ML and product teams have the historical and real-time data they need, without bespoke workarounds.

• Strong working relationships with the Data, ML, and Platform teams.

**What You’ll Bring With You

**

• Deep, hands-on Snowflake and dbt experience: modelling, semantic layers, agents & skills, testing, performance and cost tuning.

• Production experience with a pipeline orchestrator, ideally Dagster (or similar Airflow, Prefect), including dependent workloads, partial failures, and observability.

• Modern cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS/GCP) and Kubernetes experience deploying and operating containerised workloads, plus infrastructure as code (Terraform).

• Strong SQL & Python for pipelines, services, and automation.

• Software engineering discipline across CI/CD, testing, and code review.

• The ability to turn technical trade-offs into clear narratives that help stakeholders decide and trust the work.

• Experience operating data systems, including incident response, cost, and data privacy practices.

**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• Flexible remote work

• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.
